what_this_is: Local RTX 5090 A/B of levers 1+2 (b12x gate + in_proj_ba transpose) against baseline. Single GPU, podman container, C1 decode, 3x200 tokens, temperature=0, identical prompt.
profile: C1 (single sequence), MTP-3, graph decode, fp8 KV, 180k context, max-num-seqs=8
prompt: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. This is a test of the decoding speed.
method: 3x200-token greedy generations per arm, 50-token warmup before each arm, wall-time measured via perf_counter

A_baseline.description: Both levers OFF: VLLM_EXL3_B12X_N_RANGE=0 (no gate) + original linear.py (no transpose)

B_lever2_only.description: Lever 2 ON only: VLLM_EXL3_B12X_N_RANGE=0 (no gate) + patched linear.py (transpose, m>=2 guard)

C_both_levers.description: Both levers ON: default VLLM_EXL3_B12X_N_RANGE=5120-32768 (gate active) + patched linear.py (transpose)

lever_2_transpose_effect.mechanism: MTP-3 verify pass processes m>=2 tokens, triggering the transpose path for tiny-N GDN in_proj_ba layers (5120x96). The pre-transposed KxN weight runs 3.6x faster than the original TN layout.

notes: Lever 1 (b12x gate) shows only +1.0% at C1, consistent with the bare-metal rental test (+1.4% median, inconclusive). The gate routes lm_head and k/v to exl3_gemm, but the per-call GPU savings are small.

Lever 2 (in_proj_ba transpose) shows +4.4% at C1, exceeding the +3% threshold. The speedup comes from MTP-3 verify passes (m>=2) where the transpose path is active. At pure m=1 decode, the transpose is inactive.
Combined +5.4% exceeds the +3% threshold. The levers are complementary: lever 1 helps lm_head/k/v routing, lever 2 helps GDN in_proj_ba transpose.
